title: Single and merged interplanetary coronal mass ejections at 1 au, 2011-2025: derived parameters and analysis scripts
description: Derived parameters of 286 interplanetary coronal mass ejections (2011-2025) from the Richardson-Cane list, OMNI, ACE/EPAM and GOES data, Lundquist flux-rope fit parameters, example-event data, and the analysis scripts used in the manuscript 'Merged Coronal Mass Ejections at 1 au: Compression, Sublinear Magnetic Flux Addition, and No Excess Heating' submitted to Journal of Geophysical Research: Space Physics.

creators.name: Davydenkov, Igor I.
